title: A background land closes its window once land's own checkout holds the done commit, though the landing may still fail
goal: Found in the SP-wgx4pq4r review of BG-cwoyc7yh: backlog.py land rebases work/<id> and runs done --commit in the orchestrator's own checkout (bl_land.land_once) before the heavy checks, sync --push and verify_landed; a later hook of a session that launched land in the background runs ql_capture.settle_pending, which reads the item file there as done and writes the done row; if the checks or sync then fail, land switches back to the start branch (the file says doing again) but the done row stays, so a failed landing still closes the window. settle_pending writes the deferred done row only once the landing has pushed (not while the checkout is on the item's work/<id> branch mid-land), the repro exits 0, and querylog.md and usage.md say so. It reads that done from the integration main (origin/main), not the checkout file: a checkout that is detached, on a branch whose upstream is not origin/main, dirty or diverged keeps the file at doing after a landing that pushed, so the row never settled and every later prompt counted on the item's window; the second check, the former BG-p7bp24ee repro, exits 0.

run: import os,sys,json,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;co=t/'co';(co/'.git').mkdir(parents=True);(co/'.git'/'HEAD').write_text('ref: refs/heads/work/ST-aaaaaaaa\n');f=co/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog'/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json';f.parent.mkdir(parents=True);f.write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':'done'}));q.record('prompt','s1',prompt_id='p1',prompt='x');q.record('work','s1',prompt_id='p1',action='done-pending',item='ST-aaaaaaaa');r=q.settle_pending(Path(q.spool_dir()),'s1',{'cwd':str(co)},'p2');print('done rows while land holds the work branch checked out:',r);sys.exit(1 if r else 0)

import os,sys,json,subprocess,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());co=t/'co';co.mkdir();g=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(co),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();g('init','-q','-b','main');g('config','user.email','a@example.com');g('config','user.name','a');f=co/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog'/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json';f.parent.mkdir(parents=True);w=lambda s:(f.write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':s})),g('add','-A'),g('commit','-qm',s));w('doing');c1=g('rev-parse','HEAD');w('done');g('update-ref','refs/remotes/origin/main','HEAD');g('reset','-q','--hard',c1);os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;q.record('prompt','s1',prompt_id='p1',prompt='x');q.record('work','s1',prompt_id='p1',action='done-pending',item='ST-aaaaaaaa');r=q.settle_pending(Path(q.spool_dir()),'s1',{'cwd':str(co)},'p2');print('done rows after a landing pushed to origin/main while the checkout was not fast-forwarded:',r);sys.exit(0 if r else 1)

gates.question: How many seconds may each git process of ql_capture.pushed_status take inside a capture hook before the settle gives up (the row then waits for a later hook)?
A clone with no integration-remote main ref: does pushed_status fall back to the local main, as bl_land.integration_main does, or settle nothing?
options: fall back to the local main
settle nothing without the remote ref
gates.recommendation: fall back to the local main
gates.answer: fall back to the local main

notes: Merged from BG-p7bp24ee at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: its repro (done only on origin/main, the checkout lags) is the second check and still exits 1; it is the other side of this bug in the same function, settle_pending, which should read done from origin/main, not the checkout file.
